mapper.insert: insert into pay_order(order_no, user_id, sku, product_type, amount, amount_cent, state, create_time, update_time) values (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{sku}, #{productType}, #{amount}, #{amountCent}, #{state}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select id, order_no, user_id, sku, product_type, amount, amount_cent, state, out_trade_no, paid_at, granted_at, closed_at, refunded_cent, refunded_at, create_time, update_time from pay_order where order_no = #{orderNo}

select id, order_no, user_id, sku, product_type, amount, amount_cent, state, out_trade_no, paid_at, granted_at, closed_at, refunded_cent, refunded_at, create_time, update_time from pay_order where state = 'created' and create_time <= #{deadline} order by id limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into pay_reconcile_diff(run_id, order_no, user_id, order_state, order_amount, ledger_amount, refunded_cent, reason, state, create_time) values (#{runId}, #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{orderState}, #{orderAmount}, #{ledgerAmount}, #{refundedCent}, #{reason}, #{state}, now())
insert into pay_callback_log(out_trade_no, order_no, user_id, notify_seq, raw, result, create_time) values (#{outTradeNo}, #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{notifySeq}, #{raw}, #{result}, now())
